name: stimlab
description: StimLab - native CNS-stimulant computational drug-discovery suite (docking, ADMET, similarity, legal-analog, AI agent).

science.description: Networked extras (Phase D agent): libcurl for the Anthropic LLM provider. curl[ssl] resolves to Windows-native Schannel TLS here (the port's ssl feature pulls sspi on Windows), so there is no OpenSSL build. NOTE: there is intentionally no rdkit - StimLab has its own in-house cheminformatics engine in src/chem (rdkit is not a port in this vcpkg registry).
